extracted.name: Sage sour
extracted.description: Blend alcohol-free gin with lemon juice, sugar syrup, egg white and sage leaves to make this sophisticated mocktail, perfect for parties
ingredient_lines: 50ml alcohol-free gin (or infuse some gin botanicals in water)
instruction_lines: Put the gin alternative, lemon juice, sugar syrup, 3 of the sage leaves and a good handful of ice into a cocktail shaker. Shake hard until the outside of the shaker is ice cold, then double strain into a small jug.
Discard the ice and any remaining sage pieces, then pour the cocktail back into the shaker and add the egg white.
Shake it really hard to froth up the egg white, then pour into a cocktail glass or coupe. Garnish with the remaining sage leaf.
